terms.0.def: Seg tefinisit shofet, « aqeḍi ». Qarṭaǧ tfren yal aseggas sin isufaṭ, i gesem Igrikiyen d Iṛumaniyen « igelliden »: ttrusun ɣef Usqamu, qeḍḍin ger medden, war ad ḥekmen ɣef iɛesskaren (Aristu, Tasertit, II, 11). Tudrin n Tafrikt taṛumit mazal-itent frant-ten armi d aqeṛn wis snat seld Ɛisa.
terms.1.def: Asqamu n « Imɣaren » n Qarṭaǧ (gerontes i Igrikiyen, seniores i Iṛumaniyen), yettwafran seg twacult timeqqranin, yezmer ad yili s aṭas n yimttanen. Nețța i gettaɣen lmeqrer ɣef umennuɣ, talwit d tdiblumasit; iqayden ttaɣen-as-d lexbar.
terms.2.def: Asqamu amecṭuḥ, akka i t-isemma Aristu. Ɣef leḥsab n Justen (XIX, 2), meyya n yiqeḍyan ttwafernen seg Usqamu smaɛlayen ddǧehud n yiqayden mi d-uɣalen, akken ad ssentin tazmert n Imagoniyen. Ttwaɛinen i tudert meṛṛa, tawuri-nsen tṣubb ɣer yiwen useggas sɣur Hanibal, d asufeṭ deg 196 uqbel Ɛisa.
terms.3.def: Tajmaɛt n xemsa yemttanen, ur tettwassen ara ala sɣur Aristu (Tasertit, II, 11). Isqamuyen-agi ttafren iman-nsen, ttnadin deg tɣawsiwin timeqqranin, sersen imttanen n Meyya d Ukkuẕ; tawuri-nsen tameẕyant teqqim d tiɣmist.
terms.4.def: Anejmuɛ n yimezdaɣ ilelliyen deg usuq (Diyudur); awal apunik ʿm, « aɣref », i tt-id-isemmayen deg tira. Nettat i gefrazen mi ara mgaraden isufaṭ d Usqamu, yal yiwen yezmer ad inṭeq fell-as mgal lewṣayat (Aristu). Bulib (VI, 51) iḥseb belli teṭṭef azal ameqqran deg lawan n imenɣan ipunikiyen.
terms.5.def: Awal apunik yebɣa-d « aqayed », « bab », yettwamsel deg tira sɣur imttanen n tɣawsiwin yemgaraden. Isem n unmhal n iɛesskaren iqarṭaǧiyen ad yili d win (rb mḥnt, « aqayed n texxamt »), maca aẖatar aɛeskri ur yettwassen ara mliḥ.
terms.6.def: Isem seg tira iqdimen (Irmiya, 7, 31) i gefkan imussnawen n tqadmiyin i yimqamen ur nseddu i deg ttemagarent tcebbilin n yiɣsan n yigraden d yiɣersiwen ileẖsusen, s yimgayen seldat i Baɛal Hammun akked Tanit. Win n Salammbo, di Qarṭaǧ, yekka-d seg aqeṛn wis 8 armi d 146 uqbel Ɛisa. D asefk neɣ d amḍiq n yimeṭṭan igraden: amtawi mazal-it yeldi.
terms.7.def: Tayillut tameqqrant n Qarṭaǧ, tettwasemma « Udem n Baɛal » (pn bʿl) deg tira n usideg, anida tezweṛ ɣef Baɛal Hammun seg aqeṛn wis 5 uqbel Ɛisa. Tḥareb temdint, tettɣima deg lawan aṛumi s yisem n Caelestis.
terms.8.def: Azamul yettwabnan s wecbaḍu, tizirrig tanbawant d tfeẓẕet, yettban am tugna n umdan yessali iɣallen-is. Yeffeg ɣef imgayen, iẖeddan d tɣawsiwin seg aqeṛn wis 5 d wis 4 uqbel Ɛisa; iɛeddel aṭas yettwaḥsab d awezɣi ɣer Lɣerb, maca yettwaf daɣen ɣer Ccerq.
terms.9.def: Yillu ameqqran n Qarṭaǧ, bab n igenni d tmeɣra, i geldi yimgayen n tofet akked Tanit. Yettwaqeṛṛeb ɣer Ammun alibi bu uqeṛwi, sakin ɣer Kronos d Jupiter, yettɣima deg lawan aṛumi d Saturne afriqi.
terms.10.def: « Bab n igenwan », yillu ameqqran n igenni, yettwaɛbad deg umaḏal apunik d uaramiyi meṛṛa, yettban daɣen deg tira n usideg n Qarṭaǧ.
terms.11.def: « Agellid n temdint », yillu n Tyr, tamdint-tayemmat. Qarṭaǧ tettazen yal aseggas asefk ɣer umqam-is di Tyr (Diyudur, XX, 14); Igrikiyen qerben-t ɣer Hiraklis, Ibarkiyen sersen-t ɣef idrimen-nsen. Amqam-is di Gadir yeqqim yettwassen armi d lawan aṛumi.
terms.12.def: Yillu n ssiwi, yettwaqeṛṛeb ɣer Asklibyus agriki. Ɣef leḥsab n Appyan (Libika, 130), amqam-is, ameqqran akk di Qarṭaǧ, yecbeḥ Byrsa: iḥudaden ineggura gnen-t-id, sseṛɣen-t deg 146 uqbel Ɛisa.
terms.13.def: Tayillut tafinisiyt n tmeɣra d umennuɣ, tettɣima tettwaɛbad di Qarṭaǧ. Di Pirji, idgar n Caere di Etrurya, tizirrig n ddheb s snat n tutlayin (ɣer 500 uqbel Ɛisa) qeṛṛbent-tt ɣer Uni taetruskit.
terms.14.def: Tiyilluten tigrikiyen i tesɛed Qarṭaǧ s wudem ameɣtu deg 396 uqbel Ɛisa: aɛesskar n Himilkun yekkes-d amqam-nsent ɣer tama n Sarakuza, send ad t-yeẖseṛ lǧeḥ. Akken a tent-ssusem, temdint tefka-asent asideg yettwaxeddemen sɣur Igrikiyen (Diyudur, XIV, 77).
terms.15.def: Isem aṛumi n Baɛal Hammun seld 146 uqbel Ɛisa. Imqamen-is inipunikiyen (Thinissut, Bu Kurnin, El Hofra ɣer rrif n Sirta, imgayen n Ɣorfa) ttɣiment ttwazuren armi d tazwara n aqeṛn wis 4 seld Ɛisa (Lancel, Le Glay).
terms.16.def: « Tin n Igenni » : isem i deg Tanit tḥareb tettwaɛbad deg Tafrikt taṛumit, zik ɣer Qarṭaǧ, ɣef yimqamen-nni s yiman-nsen akked yimgayen yettwaweṛten seg lemtel apunik.
terms.17.def: Tira tapunikt yettwafen deg idgar n Marsiliya deg 1845, d taqarṭaǧit s telqey. Tsers, aẖiwan s aẖiwan, aẖric n usefk i d-yeqqimen i uqeddam d win i d-yeqqimen i umɛebbed. Tettwaḥerz deg Asinag n Tsenlasas n Agaraw Alemmas n Vieille Charité.
terms.18.def: Aẓru yebded yesɛan tira n usideg neɣ tugna (s tpunikt nṣb). Deg tofet, azgen n yimgayen n usefk ssawalen ɣef uzamul n Tanit, izumal d tira; ttwaxedmen zik seg weẕrem, sakin seg wezṛu, ttɛemmaren s wunuɣen n uẖaṛuf agriki.
terms.19.def: Lbabuṛ n umennuɣ i d-ilulen di Sarakuza ɣer 399 uqbel Ɛisa ddawt Denys Amɣar (Diyudur, XIV, 41–42), yuɣal d lbabuṛ ameqqran n imenɣan ipunikiyen: ɣer 300 n yimeqdafen d 120 n yiɛeskriyen. Isem-is ad yili yemmeslay ɣef tirebbuɛin n xemsa n yimeqdafen, mačči ɣef xemsa n ileqqaḍ n ssuken yettwasersen afella ɣef wayeḏ.
terms.20.def: Lbabuṛ n umennuɣ s tlata n ileqqaḍ n yimeqdafen yettwasersen afella ɣef wayeḏ, yesɛa tiɣmart n uẖenneq ɣer tazwara, yettwaxeddem seg aqeṛn wis 6 uqbel Ɛisa: ɣer 200 n yergazen deg-s, 170 seg-sen d imeqdafen. Deg 201 uqbel Ɛisa, Ṛuma teǧǧa i Qarṭaǧ ala mraw n tririmat.
terms.21.def: Lbabuṛ aɣezfan s xemsin n ileqqaḍ, irurad, yelhan i waṭas n tɣawsiwin, seg zzman imezwura n usizdeg afinisi. Ɣef leḥsab n Tirzi, Hanun yenhad sețțin seg-sen ɣef rrif n Agaraw Aṭlanti n Tafrikt.
terms.22.def: Tirrategt n lebḥer tagrikit: lbabuṛ ikeččem deg tagra n uẓaṛaṛ n ucengu, izegren-t, sakin yezzi akken ad yeẖnneq amnafeq seg idis neɣ seg deffir. Tesra iɛeskriyen yemyaswiyen aṭas, d wayen i gesnan asutel n Qarṭaǧ.
terms.23.def: Tirrategt n uẖaṣer: ttɛeddan afus n ucengu akken a t-ẖenqen seg idis, syen azal n uẓaṛaṛ ɣezzifen ugar n win n umnafeq. Ur tettuxelleṭ ara akked tirzi, taqsiṭ n tikli ɣef lebḥer.
terms.24.def: Aɣaraf n uẖdaɛ s uẖellel, yesnulfa-t-id Iṛumaniyen akken ad ssensin tamusni n usutel n Iqarṭaǧiyen deg usenhal: tbeddel amennuɣ n lebḥer ɣer umennuɣ n iɛeskriyen uḍaren. Yefka-asen lfer-nsen amezwaru deg lebḥer, di Mila deg 260 uqbel Ɛisa (Bulib, I, 22–23).
terms.25.def: Tasmi tawezlant tiberit yesɛan nnab yextawan, yelhan aṭas i uẖellel. D leslaḥ-is, akked uglaɣelɣal, n yiɛeskriyen Iberiyen n uɛesskar aqarṭaǧi.
terms.26.def: Tarbaɛt tafuqsant n ɣer 2 500 n yinamuren iqarṭaǧiyen, ddan s leslaḥ ɣezzif, ɣef leḥsab n Diyudur (XVI, 80), i tt-isekanayen tettwahudd sɣur Timulyun di Krimisus, di Sqilliya, ɣer 340 uqbel Ɛisa.
terms.27.def: Iɛeskriyen uqeṛḍasen n tegzirin n Baliyar, ttwasɣaren seg tmeẕẕuɣt; ddan s tlata n tɣamsa akken ad wten s tanzagin yemgaraden (Strabun, III, 5, 1), ssekcamen aẓru d tirgalin n rrṣaṣ.
terms.28.def: Lmizan asami yuɣalen d idrim n Qarṭaǧ. Idrimen ipunikiyen imezwura ttwaxedmen di Sqilliya akken ad xelsen iɛeskriyen uqeṛḍasen; Qarṭaǧ ur teldi ara dduṛ-ines armi d tlemmast n aqeṛn wis 4 uqbel Ɛisa. Di Ispanya, Ibarkiyen ssufuɣen-d išikal n lfeṭṭa n lqima ɛlayen.
terms.29.def: Lmizan d uḥsab agriki, ɣer 26 kg n lfeṭṭa. Lexlaṣ i d-tessers Ṛuma ttwabnan s talanṭ: 3 200 deg 241, 1 200 nniḍen deg 237, sakin 10 000 ara ixelsen deg xemsin iseggasen deg 201 uqbel Ɛisa.
terms.30.def: Taẖsayt n yiselman yesɛan ddehn yettwaɛfsen, yettwaseqdac deg uẖeddim n tmecta d ddwa. Ifinisiyen-Ipunikiyen ssizdigen aseqdec-is ɣef Agaraw Alemmas; Ṛuma tekkes-d lesnaɛa-agi n ssla ɣef wudem ameqqran, am di Baelo Claudia ɣer rrif n Qadis.
terms.31.def: Ssbeɣ aɣlayan akk n zzman aqdim, yettwakksen seg weẖbic n lebḥer, murex: yesra-d ugar n yimiyat akken ad d-yeffeɣ kra n igram seg ssbeɣ. D tamusni tafinisiyt, teǧǧa-d di Kerkwan taftist n yiẖbac yettwaheẕẕen zdat tẖuddamin; Jerba teqqim tettwassen fell-as deg lawan aṛumi.
terms.32.def: Ccrab aẖelwi seg tẕurin iqquren ɣer yiṭij, tamusni teqqim tettwassen n Qarṭaǧ. Kulumel (XII, 39) yeḥfeḏ tarecfa-ines ɣef leḥsab n Magun, qrib awal ɣef wawal.
terms.33.def: Asfeṣfeẕ war anekcum, yettwabeddel sɣur Hirudut (IV, 196): seld Tigejda n Hercule, Iqarṭaǧiyen sersen ssuma-nsen ɣef uẖali, ṭṭfen deffir; imezdaɣ sersen ddheb ɣer tama, syen ɛawden armi d amtawi, war ula d yiwen wawal.
terms.34.def: Tasekla n tfellaḥt s 28 n yedlisen, yura-tt s tpunikt Magun. Seld 146 uqbel Ɛisa, Usqamu aṛumi yesra tasuqilt-ines ɣer talatinit (Plin, XVIII, 22); Varrun d Kulumel bedren-tt d taẓuri yettwamɣaren.
terms.35.def: Isem afinisi n Qarṭaǧ: « Tamdint tamaynut ». Igrikiyen xedmen-t-id Karkidun, Iṛumaniyen Carthago. Isem-agi yettwafka daɣen i Qarṭaǧant, yettwasers di Ispanya sɣur Hasdrubal.
terms.36.def: Taɣaltit-tazniq n Qarṭaǧ, tecbeḥ-itt umqam n Ecmun. Igrikiyen qeṛṛben isem-is ɣer byrsa, « aglim n tfunast », syen tamsirt n Elisa tetteḥẕeb aglim ɣer tẖuzawin akken ad teẖseb tamurt (Justen, XVIII, 5); azar ameɣtu n wawal, ahat d asami, yettwamyeslay fell-as armi d assa.
terms.37.def: Ldgar n umennuɣ dayrawi n Qarṭaǧ, yeffer deffir n ldgar n ttjara amrabaɛ. Ɣef leḥsab n Appyan (Libika, 96), yesɛa 220 n yimukan i lbabuṛen n umennuɣ, deg tlemmast-is, ɣef tegzirt tamecṭuḥt, axxam n unmhal n lebḥer. Snat n tagnatin n Salammbo ḥerzent tuɣmist-is.
terms.38.def: Aẖali ameqqran ɣer ugafa n temdint, ɣer La Marsa n wass-agi, s tebḥirin d ixxamen ɛlayen, yettwabna s telqey ifessusen ugar. Imeqqranen n leṣl sɛan din axxamen-nsen; Scipiyun Emilyen yeẖdem anekcum deg uhuzi, deg 147 uqbel Ɛisa (Appyan, Libika, 117).
terms.39.def: Aɣerbaz n Qarṭaǧ n wass-agi, ɣer rrif n idgaren ipunikiyen, isem-is yekka-d seg udlis n Flaubert (1862). Tofet n Qarṭaǧ yettwaf-d din deg 1921.
terms.40.def: Tamdint tapunikt n ẖali Bun, yettwaǧǧa ɣer tlemmast n aqeṛn wis 3 uqbel Ɛisa, werǧin tettwabna tikkelt-nniḍen: teḥreẕ s telqey asaḏas n temdint tapunikt, s ixxamen-is yesɛan tazeqqa n waman d uẖali s uzamul n Tanit. Tettwajerred deg lwert n umaḏal n UNESCO deg 1985.
terms.41.def: Awal agriki, « lexla », yettwaseqdac sɣur yimusnawen n umezruy i tmurt tafellaḥt n Qarṭaǧ. Tezdi azgen ameqqran n Tunes n wass-agi, tesseč temdint.
terms.42.def: Iswaq d tmura ɛlayen ɣef rrif n tgezzayt tamecṭuḥt (tagna n Qabes), aɣbalu n ssɛaya i Qarṭaǧ. Masinisa yeṭṭef aẖric-nsen seg 193 uqbel Ɛisa, Ṛuma teggi ad tḥekkem (Titus Livyus, XXXIV, 62).
terms.43.def: « Aẖric agellid » yettwajerren sɣur Ṛuma seld 146 uqbel Ɛisa akken ad yefreq tamnaḏt tamaynut n Afrika, tamurt tasaḏast n Qarṭaǧ, seg tagelda tanumidit.
terms.44.def: Gadir, « leswaṛ », ass-agi Qadis: tamnaḏt n Tyr seld tabuɣezt n Gibraltar, tamɛawant n Qarṭaǧ. Amqam-is n Melqart yeqqim yettwassen armi d lawan aṛumi, syen-d i gennulfa Himilkun ɣer ugafa ɣef webrid n lqesdir.
terms.45.def: Tamnaḏt n Tyr ɣer ugafa n Qarṭaǧ, Plin (XVI, 216) issers-itt deg 1101 uqbel Ɛisa, send tiqcer-ines timezwura yettwassnen. Tamɛawant sakin timnazaɛt n Qarṭaǧ, tekcem ɣer idis n Ṛuma deg 149, tuɣal d taneflest n tmnaḏt n Afrika.
terms.46.def: Carthago Nova n Iṛumaniyen, yettwasers ɣer 227 uqbel Ɛisa sɣur Hasdrubal Ucebḥan s yisem n Qart-Ḥadasht: taneflest n Ibarkiyen di Ispanya, ɣer rrif n lmeɛdan n lfeṭṭa ɛlayen. Hanibal yeffeg seg-s deg tefsut n 218; Scipiyun yeṭṭef-itt deg 209.
terms.47.def: Isem aqdim n tbuɣezt n Gibraltar, talast n umaḏal yettwassnen i Igrikiyen. Qarṭaǧ teḥares fell-as, tsekcam syen-d tirzigin-ines n Agaraw Aṭlanti, tin n Hanun ɣer usammar, tin n Himilkun ɣer ugafa.
terms.48.def: Tagzirt tafinisiyt n lɣerb n Sqilliya, tamɛawant n Qarṭaǧ, yeṭṭef-itt yehudd-itt Denys n Sarakuza deg 397 uqbel Ɛisa (Diyudur, XIV, 47–53). Ttwaf-d din deg 1979 « ilemẓi n Motya », tuga n merẖmaṛ n aqeṛn wis 5.
terms.49.def: Tira taɛrabt n wawal alatini Africa, yettwaseqdac deg lqern n lwesṭ i Tunes d rrif-is, s Lqirwan d taneflest. Isem-agi yekmel win n tmnaḏt taṛumit i d-ilulen seg tmurt n Qarṭaǧ.
terms.50.def: Seg latini Punicus, seg Poenus, talɣa talatinit n wagriki Phoinix, « Afinisi ». Awal-agi yesmekta tagemmi d tutlayt n Qarṭaǧ: afinisi n Lɣerb, tutlayt tasamit yettwaran seg uyeffus ɣer uẕelmaḏ, mazal-itt yettwameslay deg tmura n Tafrikt deg lawan n Sidi Ɛugusṭin, ɣer 400 seld Ɛisa.
terms.51.def: Talɣa taneggarut, taɛejlant, n tira tapunikt, yettwaseqdac di Tafrikt Ugafa seld 146 uqbel Ɛisa armi d leqṛun imezwura seld Ɛisa. Tikwal tjerred-d ivuwayen s kra n tsekkilin.
terms.52.def: Tira s 22 n tsekkilin, akk d tiẖerfin, tettwajerr seg uyeffus ɣer uẕelmaḏ. Tettwaweṛt i Igrikiyen, d jeddi-s n tira tagrikit d talatinit, syen, s uaramiyi, n tira tabraniyt d taɛrabt.
terms.53.def: Tutlayt d tira n yimezdaɣ idmaḍen n Tafrikt Ugafa, ijedda n Imaziɣen. Tira s snat n tutlayin, tapunikt-talibikt, n umḍal n Dugga (aqeṛn wis 2 uqbel Ɛisa) tuɣal d tasarut i usefhem n tsekkilin-ines.
terms.54.def: Aẖali n tɣelwinin n weẕru d merẖmaṛ yettwasersen deg uɣerman azeggaɣ, tikwal yeɛlayen s uzamul n Tanit (Kerkwan, idis n usammar n Byrsa). Yettwasers i aqeṛn wis 3 uqbel Ɛisa, iẖaliyen-agi sraden-aɣ ad nɛeqqel belli lmuzayik mačči ala tin Lagris i tt-isnulfan.
terms.55.def: Tarrategt n lbenyan tapunikt: tizerrig n yiẓran imeqqranen, ttwasersen s wudem beddun d wudem genzun ɛawed ɛawed, ẖeddment taẓuyit n tewrriqin timecṭuḥin. Tettwaf di Kerkwan, teqqim-d deg Tafrikt taṛumit, armi d uqeṛṣul n Dugga.
terms.56.def: Udmawen n ṭṭbel sseḥman, yesɛan izirar leqqa d yimi yettwaẖennwen, tikwal ɛlayen s tẓegwa tiqarbuzyin. Azar-nsen ahat d agmaḍi, ttwaheẕẕen neɣ ttwasersen deg yiẖemmaren akken ad ssutren leǧnun (tagara n aqeṛn wis 7 – wis 6 uqbel Ɛisa).
terms.57.def: Tisebbaṭ timecṭuḥin n nnḥas ucebban, llant aṭas deg yiẖemmaren seld aqeṛn wis 7 uqbel Ɛisa, qqnent ɣer tsiridt n umeṭṭi, sɛant azal n ttaẓ (Lancel). Seg aqeṛn wis 5, ttwajerrent s wunuɣen imaṣriyen neɣ igrikiyen n Agaraw Alemmas asarag.
terms.58.def: Tirni d izemzam n tḥebbukt n uskaraṛ, ttwajerrent s weɣẕaẕ, aṭas-nsent ttuɛebbint-d seg tẖuddamin timaṣriyin neɣ tifinisiyin: azamul n ddwa ameqqran n Maṣer ɣef taẓuri tapunikt. Seld tlemmast n aqeṛn wis 4, tijerriwin ɣef lɛajin n zzaǧ, iɛdilen ugar, ttaɣent amḍiq-nsent.
terms.59.def: Isem agriki n twacult i d-ilulen seg usemyed n yimezdaɣ ifinisiyen d Yilibiyen n Tafrikt. Addad-nsen d tmurt-nsen, ahat ɣer usammar n Qarṭaǧ, mazal-iten d tiɣmist; Tirzi n Hanun teqqaṛ-d belli iṛuḥ ad yesers « tudrin n Libufinisiyen ».
terms.60.def: Twacult n yiqayden i d-ilulen seg Magun, tḥekkem ɣef Qarṭaǧ deg leqṛun wis 6 d wis 5 uqbel Ɛisa (Justen, XIX). Tesger aɛesskar n iɛeskriyen uqeṛḍasen, tesnuzget tamurt tafriqit n deffir, tenhad imenɣan n Sqilliya, armi d uxsaṛan n Himera deg 480; Meyya d Ukkuẕ ad ttwasersen akken ad ssentin tazmert-agi n twacult.
terms.61.def: Twacult n Hamilqar Barka — seg tpunikt brq, « asigna » — akked warraw-is Hanibal, Hasdrubal d Magun, akked wawtul-is Hasdrubal Ucebḥan. Seld 237 uqbel Ɛisa, bnan di Ispanya tazmert qrib tilellit, d ssas n tmenɣut tis snat tapunikt.
terms.62.def: Tlata n imenɣan ger Ṛuma d Qarṭaǧ: 264–241 (Sqilliya), 218–201 (Hanibal di Italya, armi d Zama) akked 149–146 uqbel Ɛisa, i gefukken s uhuddu n temdint.
terms.63.def: Tuccḍa n yiɛeskriyen uqeṛḍasen i d-yuɣalen seg Sqilliya war lexlaṣ, ddukkelen-d yid-sen tudrin tilibiyin (241–238 uqbel Ɛisa). Hamilqar Barka yehudd-itt seld amennuɣ war aḥunu, i d-iḥekku Bulib (I, 65–88); Ṛuma tesseqdec aferyun akken a teṭṭef Sardinya.
terms.64.def: Taqsiṭ, tettwaḥerz s tgrikt, n tirzi n Hanun ɣef rrif n Agaraw Aṭlanti n Tafrikt ɣer 500 uqbel Ɛisa, s sețțin n pentekunṭiren. Ad tili d tasuqilt n tira tapunikt yettwaskanen deg umqam n Qarṭaǧ; d ccahada taqburt akk n unadi n Lɣerb n Tafrikt.
terms.65.def: « Laman apunik »: tanfalit talatinit i d-yuɣalen d azamul n lxiyana. Titus Livyus (XXI, 4) isers ɣef Hanibal « lxiyana ugar n tapunikt ». D asekkil n udabu aṛumi, war ma d tigawin ɣẖalent aṭas seg tin n Ṛuma s yiman-is.
terms.66.def: « Ilaq ad tettwahudd Qarṭaǧ » : Katun Amɣar ad yili yefka tiɣẕi-agi deg tagara n yal adiwenni-ines deg Usqamu deg iseggasen n 150 uqbel Ɛisa (Plutark, Katun Amɣar, 27 ; Plin, XV, 74). Iɣbula bedrent tikti-agi; tanfalit talatinit s telqey d tiddit i d-ixedmen ɣer deffir.
terms.67.def: Tamnaḏt taṛumit i gefren Qiṣer, tettwasers ddawt Ugustus (44–29 uqbel Ɛisa) ɣef wemḍiq s yiman-is n temdint tapunikt. Tuɣal d taneflest n Afrika Proconsulaire akked yiwet seg tudrin timeqqranin n Tgelda.
